context_policy.compatible_rule: COMPATIBLE is admissible only when the policy explicitly lists COMPATIBLE and supplies a joint-admissibility witness or rule.
context_policy.ordered_rule: ORDERED is admissible only when the policy explicitly lists ORDERED and supplies a typed ordering relation over the orientation domain.
context_policy.conflict_rule: CONFLICT rejects only when an explicit incompatible-constraint witness is present; otherwise the result is unresolved.
context_policy.incomparable_rule: INCOMPARABLE blocks admissibility evaluation and is never converted to rejection by absence alone.

conflict_witness_schema.rule: An unvalidated conflict claim cannot reject an organization.

candidate_identity.conservative_rule: Two candidate outputs collapse only when CanonicalRef(candidate_1) equals CanonicalRef(candidate_2).
candidate_identity.distinct_reference_rule: Distinct candidate references remain distinct even when labels, structures, finite outputs, or contexts appear similar.
candidate_identity.alternative_representation_rule: Alternative representations are not collapsed without a separate authorized result-equivalence relation.

candidate_set_outcomes.meaning: No candidate result generated; reason must be recorded and is not automatically a contradiction.
One candidate reference exists; deterministic MTO still requires totality and canonical selection semantics.
Multiple distinct candidate references exist; MTO selection is blocked.
Candidates normalize to one canonical reference; duplicate representation may be removed by normalization only.

open_obligations: Define the typed ordering relation for ORDERED orientations.
Define candidate RT canonical references and their source authority.
Define deterministic selection only after multiple-distinct candidate behavior is characterized.
Define whether empty candidate sets are expected, blocked, or invalid for each context.
nonclaims: No COMPATIBLE or ORDERED policy is active canonically.
No conflict is valid without a witness.
No substantive result equivalence is defined.
No deterministic MTO selector is authorized.
